description: Clean-room RTL logic synthesiser (Synopsys Design Compiler / Cadence Genus class): reads a Verilog-2001 subset and emits a structural gate-level netlist built only from primitive gates and a DFF cell. Judged by SAT-based formal equivalence (complete proof for combinational designs, temporal induction with a bounded fallback for sequential ones) over 13 hidden designs, plus netlist legality and a simulation differential; area is reported against a production synthesiser but is not pass/fail.
source: hidden RTL design set (tasks/synth_verilog/hidden/designs); Yosys + Icarus Verilog as oracle
